responsibility: This file implements GCC’s page-based “bag-of-pages” garbage collector backend. It owns the concrete allocation strategy of grouping same-sized objects into pages, page-table lookup structures for mapping pointers to page metadata, mark/sweep collection over page allocation bitmaps, allocation-context depth handling, free-page caching and reclamation, finalizer/context bookkeeping, and precompiled-header serialization and reload of GC-managed objects and page tables, making it the main runtime collector used by the compiler when full GGC is enabled.
